findings.summary: Minus signs on the fund returns and shekel differences in the fund list look like losses and put the reader off the funds.
The final amount uses the default 10,000 plus 500 a month, so the number the reader remembers is not for their own money.
The account list is very long and its numbers are nearly the same; the reader almost gave up.
In the comparison box, 'less' and 'more' do not say whether the difference is good or bad.
IBI shows up both as an account and as the recommended fund, which is confusing.
Jargon such as custody fees (דמי משמרת), trustee (נאמן) and fixed/variable (קבועים/משתנים) is not explained in plain words.
The page gives no clear first step telling the reader to open the account.
